case.Subject: Members cannot find other members in the directory

comments.CommentBody: This comes from our volunteer coordinators across the eleven museums rather than from me, and it has come up at three of the last four coordinator meetings, so I said I would raise it properly.

Members ask us for other members by region almost every week and all we can offer them is a search on a name, so our staff answer that by email one at a time. The volunteer coordinators get most of these because the person asking usually wants somebody near enough to share a lift to an opening, and a lift is a regional question, not a name question.
Thank you, and the lift sharing detail is the part that makes this concrete. Roughly how many of these does a coordinator field in a month, if you have any sense of it across the eleven sites?

I asked three of them before writing this. Between four and twelve each a month, with the larger museums at the top of that range, so call it sixty across the alliance. None of them is a hardship on its own, which is precisely why it has taken three meetings to say out loud.
